recognize_zh: 新生兒周邊血中出現數顆胚芽球，細胞質深藍、邊緣有細胞質泡狀突起（cytoplasmic bleb），符合巨核母細胞（megakaryoblast）型態；背景可見形狀不規則的血小板，配合 Down 症候群即指向 TAM。
features: Several blasts, variable in size (small to large), with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely granular chromatin
Deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with cytoplasmic blebs/tag-like projections (megakaryoblast-like)
One smaller blast with a cytoplasmic vacuole
Background with an irregular, granular platelet and a large pale-staining platelet-like fragment
Red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional echinocytes/crenated forms
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear from a neonate shows circulating blasts of variable size with high N:C ratios, finely dispersed chromatin and scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm; one blast shows a prominent cytoplasmic bleb, a feature suggestive of megakaryoblastic differentiation. Platelets include irregular granular forms and a large pale-staining platelet-like fragment. Red cells show mild poikilocytosis. In a neonate with trisomy 21 and a GATA1 mutation, findings are consistent with transient abnormal myelopoiesis.

ddx.dx: Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome (ML-DS)
ddx.vs: ML-DS usually presents after the neonatal period (typically before age 4-5) with persistent disease and additional mutations, whereas TAM appears in the first days of life and usually resolves spontaneously; morphology alone cannot separate them.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia in a non-Down syndrome infant
ddx.vs: Morphology is similar, but absence of trisomy 21/GATA1 mutation and frequent fusion genes such as CBFA2T3::GLIS2 or RBM15::MRTFA distinguish it.
Reactive states show a left-shifted granulocytic series with toxic changes rather than blasts with cytoplasmic blebs.

ddx.dx: Circulating normal neonatal blasts or NRBC
ddx.vs: Occasional blasts may be seen in stressed neonates, and nucleated red cells have condensed chromatin and polychromatic cytoplasm without blebs.
